params.name: carrier
params.description: The preffered last mile carrier the shipment should use for delivery.

params.name: currency
params.description: The ISO 4217 currency code for the **value** parameter and rates that are returned.

params.name: dg_codes
params.description: A string or array of [dangerous good codes](/#tag/DangerousGoods) contained in the shipment.

params.name: entry_point
params.description: The code for the drop off location. See [Entry Points](/#tag/EntryPoints) for a list of codes.

params.name: exit_point
params.description: The IATA port where the shipment should enter for last mile delivery. Providing this limits results to only those routes with the matching port.

params.name: height
params.description: The height of the shipment in CM.

params.name: insurance
params.description: By default all shipments except for BoxC Post include insurance covering up to $30 of the total item value including shipping cost. Setting this to true will increase the insured value for an additional fee.

params.name: irregular
params.description: Indicates this shipment was packaged in irregular shaped polybag or soft packaging to assist in calculating the volumetric weight.

params.name: is_return
params.description: Indicates this shipment is a return.

params.name: length
params.description: The length of the shipment in CM.

params.name: postal_code
params.description: The destination Postal Code or ZIP Code. Conditional.

params.name: province
params.description: The destination province / state code. Conditional.

params.name: value
params.description: The total value of the items to calculate tax and insurance. Used with currency.

params.name: weight
params.description: The weight of the shipment in KG.

params.name: width
params.description: The width of the shipment in CM.
